title: RoPE Carousel
blurb: A Victorian carousel for Rotary Position Embeddings: each horse is a frequency pair; drag to advance position and watch phases spin.

title: Byte Pair Forge
blurb: A blacksmith forge for Byte-Pair Encoding: hammer the hottest letter pairs until words become tokens.

title: Expert Post
blurb: A 1920s brass pneumatic-tube mailroom: each token is sealed in a capsule and whooshed to specialist desks by a toy Mixture-of-Experts router.

title: Token Departures
blurb: A split-flap departures board of next-token odds. Pull the temperature and top-p levers, watch the odds re-flap, dispatch a word.

title: Snowflake Net
blurb: Fold paper like a ReLU net folds space, make one cut, unfold a decision boundary.

title: Phase Choir
blurb: Kuramoto lattice whose coupling is a tiny random neural map. Move to entrain; click to re-roll the score.

title: Latent Quicksilver
blurb: A liquid-metal isosurface of a random Fourier-feature field. Move to warp the latent; click to re-roll a new creature.

title: Diffusion Bloom
blurb: Particles reverse-diffuse from noise into form. Move to condition the score field; click to re-noise and bloom again.

title: Neural Storm
blurb: 262,144 GPU particles ride the vector field of a live neural network. Move to bend its inputs, click to mutate its weights.

title: Attention Loom
blurb: Type a sentence, hover a word, and watch toy self-attention weights stretch out as red threads.
